usedFor: Gmail receives the enquiries, and Sangam CRM keeps each sender as a lead through “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Email Arrives” in Gmail, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: Each incoming enquiry becomes a lead, or updates one that already exists for that email or phone.

watchOut: “New Email Arrives” is polling, so filter by label or sender or every newsletter becomes a lead.
